This issue tracks explicit open questions in the [wiki](https://sw-wiki.maxsp.de/parts#control-surfaces).

The quotations below preserve the scope of each source. A resource-only article can lack a formula that a separate native-code investigation has partly recovered. Reconcile those findings before treating every quoted item as wholly undecoded.

## Recorded gaps

**Practical behavior guidance**

> Area fields are configuration; force equations were not decoded.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/categories/0/limitations/0`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> Lift or force against area and speed; the shipped lift_force (0.25) may not be applied by this build.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/categories/0/sections/3/body`

## Completion criteria

- Recover the relevant routine or run a reproducible measurement against the identified game build.
- Record equations, units, bounds, assumptions and executable addresses or measurement inputs.
- Update the wiki guidance and its extractor, retaining citations and any remaining uncertainty.
- Add or update an interactive graph when the recovered formula supports one.
- Re-run the relevant source checks and website checks.

comments.body: Mostly answered in 63f3d20: the force equation, the native 24 that replaces lift_force, the 15 m/s threshold, the wing term and radian deflection are now on the wiki (see investigation/control-surfaces.md). Still open: how the application cap scale S works across bodies joined by locked joints (static trace of 0x1404be190). Leaving this issue open for that.

title: Control surfaces: decode remaining behavior and formulas
